name: Moe Moe: No Limit Off Beat Action Shooting
summary: A doujin game created by the now defunct Japanese team Make Of Enjoy (M. O. E.). This game is a platform fighting game featuring characters from various Manga and Visual Novel franchises, as well as two original characters. This game focuses on projectile shooting combat, and features character-specific specials and supers.
